purpose: Verify fresh reader contexts after final integration with current main.

comparison.digestDefinition: canonicalSha256 of [questionId + colon + system, contextSha256, contextBytes] rows sorted by the first element using localeCompare.

reproduction.description: Requires the checksum-pinned cached dataset, saved reader and unit reports, and three compact exclusion reports.
